name: Sherlock Holmes and The Secret Weapon
source:
Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon invites you to step into the shoes of the world's best detective and join him on a thrilling adventure of mystery and deceit. Set in 1940s London, the challenge allows you to investigate a sinister plot involving a stolen weapon that could turn the tide of World War II.

[Edited from [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDK3V5DF]Amazon[/url]]
translation:
《夏洛克·福尔摩斯与秘密武器》邀你化身这位举世闻名的神探，与他一同踏上一场充满悬念与诡计的惊险旅程。故事发生于20世纪40年代的伦敦，你将深入调查一桩围绕失窃武器展开的险恶阴谋——而这件武器，足以扭转第二次世界大战的战局。

[摘自[url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDK3V5DF]Amazon[/url]（经编辑）]
